description: This bar chart illustrates the “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” for two large language models — GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini — under three experimental conditions: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark blue). The vertical axis ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, representing the accuracy of self-reported internal preferences. For GPT-4o, the Control condition shows low accuracy (~0.10), Before Training is higher (~0.55), and After Training reaches ~0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near zero (~0.01), Before Training is ~0.50, and After Training is ~0.75 — similar to GPT-4o. Error bars indicate variability, with larger uncertainty in the Control condition for both models. The chart visually demonstrates that introspection training substantially improves self-report accuracy in both models, with minimal difference between the two models post-training. The legend clearly maps colors to conditions, and the x-axis labels identify the models. The data supports the paper’s claim that LLMs can improve their ability to describe internal decision-driving processes through introspection training.
